ns2:course.label: Pricing Strategy and Tactics
ns2:course.description: Develops concepts and techniques for formulating and administering prices in a variety of business situations. Focuses on understanding the internal and external environment through relevant information acquisition and analysis for developing appropriate pricing strategies and tactics. Prerequisite: First year of the MBA program or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: First year of the MBA program or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MBA: (PT) Business Adm -- UIUC, MS: Technology Management-UIUC, or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
